items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: Durden and you. Oh, I'm born there in Durden and Philip.

ctx.x: That's where you were born, you know. Who lived in Durden and St. Philip?
Durden and you. Oh, I'm born there in Durden and Philip. I didn't understand you. Yeah, I'm born in St. Philip and Durden.
